questions.prompt: It's Pikmin Day tonight — the tiny explorers are out marching, whistling, and hauling treasures bigger than they are. You step into their little world for a minute. Which explorer are you tonight?

options.text: Charging ahead — treasure first, questions later.
Wandering slow — sniffing every flower on the way.
Checking the map first — I want the whole route planned.
Buzzing everywhere — so many little guys, so much to do.

questions.prompt: Final Fantasy XIV's Evercold just got pushed back at the Tokyo Fan Fest tonight — the wait for that world gets longer. How does the longer wait sit with you right now?

options.text: Still hyped — a longer wait just builds the moment.
Patient and steady — good things take their time.
A bit flat — I was already packed and ready to go.
Drifting to other games — I'll come back when it's here.

questions.prompt: The first public Switch 2 emulator is out tonight, and you're giving it a spin — but it's early days, so it stutters right when you're getting into it. What's your call?

options.text: Pushing through the stutters — rough edges and all.
Waiting for a smoother build — it'll still be there.
Lost in the settings — too many toggles, losing the thread.
Calling it — tonight it's more chore than game.

questions.prompt: Halloween's over, the costumes are coming off tonight, and the candy bowl is still sitting out on the table. If someone handled the food for the night-after wind-down, what would you want on the table?

options.text: Something warm and slow — comfort food after the big night.
Finger food to graze on — a little of everything, no fuss.
Something light — I want to feel clear, not weighed down.
The full leftover spread — bowl, snacks, the works.

questions.prompt: Back in the Pikmin world tonight — tiny footsteps, rustling leaves, and that little whistle calling the crew together. What does it sound like around you?

options.text: Bright and chirpy — little voices bouncing all around.
A soft hum underneath — gentle, easy, holding the scene.
A bold little fanfare — the crew marching, all together.
A tense edge — quiet, then a rustle you can't place.

questions.prompt: Evercold isn't coming tonight after all — the wait stretches on, and the next hour is yours while that world stays on the horizon. What do you want the wait to feel like?

options.text: Buzzing — counting down, ready whenever it lands.
Steady — I'll get there when I get there.
Warming up — getting little things done first.
Scattered — too many tabs open, none of them the game.
